prompt: Create ONE polished full-body adult woman collectible fashion illustration, vertical 1:2, both complete shoes inside frame with ground margin, thin ivory rounded border. No text, logos, real team badges, watermark or copied trademark patterns. Refined CLEAN semi-realistic anime illustration, precise thin lines, smooth controlled shading, clear texture differences. Reference1 is rendering ONLY: never copy its outfit, pose, head angle, face or background. Reference2 is brand material/structure research ONLY: do not copy whole outfit, model, colours or print. Recompose intentionally with bold wearable editorial proportions. Head absolutely upright, neck vertical, ears level; no sideways head tilt, no coy hair-touch pose. Theme: Opera Night. Coherent group atmosphere: opera-house foyer and broad stone staircase before curtain, restrained warm theatre light and formal confidence. This card alone has a distinct dominant palette: 午夜蓝／金／象牙; target colours #243B61,#BA9C5A,#EEE5D4. Do not dilute all colours into beige or grey. Outfit: Midnight-blue opaque crepe ankle evening column dress with restrained original gold stepped-line embroidery rising along ONE side, broad ivory detachable sculptural shoulder panel folded into a short cape, navy low fine-strap heels. Reduced ornament, new asymmetry and colour; no copied couture embroidery, tiara or bridal train. Material targets (designer choices, not certifications): 绉缎／局部珠绣／挺绸. Hair: sleek angular chin bob with one tightly braided temple. Pose: A decisive natural walking stride across a low threshold, shoulders balanced, one arm swings while other holds a small original folded bag low; head upright looking forward, not over shoulder. Scene: opera-house foyer and broad stone staircase before curtain, restrained warm theatre light and formal confidence, location variant 3: a low broad step and open passage, three-quarter view. Make theme clear through clothes and mood, not only props. Keep hands anatomically natural, no excessive background clutter.
